caption: The drawing depicts a model structure that appears to be a small building or stable, primarily painted in muted green and red tones with some areas showing signs of wear or rust-like marks. The building has a pitched roof colored dark grey and features a large arched opening on the side facing the viewer, along with lattice-style panel decorations on the walls. In front of the structure, there is a donkey figure painted in dark brown, positioned as if it is pushing or interacting with a small red box connected to the building. The entire assembly is mounted on a rectangular brown base. Off to the upper left side of the drawing, there is a smaller illustration showing a brown dog in front of a white table with angular lines, drawn in a simplified style compared to the main objects. The artist's signature, "CHRIST MAKENOS", is present in the bottom right corner of the image. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white.
title: Toy Bank: Mule and Manger
